Exercise A

Mixed practice

This is optional practice for the whole week. Choose the correct form for each gap, then press Check.

Before you start — optional, not marked
This is just to get you thinking. You can leave it empty and it does not count towards your score.
Twelve mixed gaps

Exercise B

Recommend it to a friend

A friend is moving to your city and asks: “What is the best way to find a flat / meet people / get around?” Reply with a recommendation.

Word count: 0

Use one modifier (far, a lot, slightly), one superlative and one sentence with too, enough, so or such. Write 60–80 words.
